description: Reads the re-notification state of one webinar: whether the date was changed and the new invitation is still pending, how many registered people would receive it, and the banner text and button the page shows. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks whether everyone was told about the new date, or before re-sending the emails (that is wi_resend_webinar_mails). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_renotification_status
title: Read whether the registrants were told about a new date
